ops.body:
Defer candidate 3
Question: Candidate 3 (governor ambient): on this host fseventsd load is mostly other work, and the 2026-09 fix measured 2,000 deletions/s moving it by less than its noise, so the ambient-relative throttle barely sees the daemon's own cost. Which change should the next PR make?
Options: Self-CPU budget (Recommended) | Cap learned ambient | Stop floor-window learning | Defer candidate 3
